dimensions.assessment: Affects federal contracting officers across executive agencies, potential contractor personnel, and bidding contractors.
dimensions.evidence: A solicitation may not set forth any minimum education requirement for proposed contractor personnel in order for a bidder to be eligible

dimensions.assessment: Changes hiring and bidding qualifications by disallowing arbitrary education requirements unless explicitly justified.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits federal contract bid solicitations for contractor personnel from including minimum educational requirements unless the contracting officer justifies the requirements.

dimensions.assessment: No specific spending amounts or economic totals are stated in the source text.
Amends title 41 of the United States Code, requires OMB guidance, and mandates a GAO compliance report.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 33 of title 41, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment applied to future solicitations.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to solicitations issued on or after the date that is 15 months

missing_information: Total number of federal contracts or personnel affected annually

importance_detail.rationale: The bill places restrictions and justification requirements on minimum education requirements in federal contract solicitations across executive agencies, affecting contracting officers, federal contractors, and personnel.
